handoff.purpose: Contains methods for identity verification, watermark recording, and freshness checking.

symbols.name: _verify_identity
symbols.note: Private method that checks if backend reproduces anchor vector; updates identity_verified set and DB timestamp on success.

symbols.name: verify_index_identity
symbols.note: Public method that forces identity verification and returns status.

symbols.name: record_journal_watermark
symbols.note: Inserts or updates journal watermark with validation against backward movement and hash change.

symbols.name: journal_watermark
symbols.note: Retrieves watermark from DB; returns JournalPosition or None.

symbols.name: journal_freshness
symbols.note: Compares recorded watermark to observed position; returns status: fresh, stale, journal_forked, or unanchored.

symbols.name: _store_batch
symbols.note: Stores embeddings for events; method body incomplete in this chunk.

claims.text: Return a refusal status when the backend no longer matches the index.
claims.why: The method returns an OperationStatus from _status on various failure conditions (invalid_index, embedder_unavailable, invalid_embedding_response, model_drift).

claims.text: None means 'safe to proceed': either the identity anchor still reproduces, or there is no anchor yet to reproduce.
claims.why: The method returns None when anchor is None, when already verified, or when verification succeeds.

claims.text: Re-check an index against the live backend, ignoring the cache.
claims.why: The method calls _verify_identity with force=True, which bypasses _identity_verified cache.

claims.text: Refuses to move backwards, and refuses a changed content_hash at an unchanged position - the journal this index derives from is supposed to be append-only, so either would mean the derivation is no longer sound.
claims.why: The method checks if position < existing position (raises ValueError) and if position equals existing but content_hash differs (raises ValueError).

claims.text: Codes: fresh, stale, journal_forked, unanchored. unanchored means freshness is UNKNOWN - it is never a claim that the index is up to date.
claims.why: The method returns status with codes 'fresh', 'stale', 'journal_forked', and 'unanchored' as documented.

observations.what: Method _verify_identity uses _status helper and references IDENTITY_DRIFT_TOLERANCE constant not defined in this chunk.
record_journal_watermark raises ValueError on invalid conditions; no exception handling shown.
journal_freshness returns 'fresh' when both positions equal and content_hashes are None or equal; if both None, no hash comparison occurs.
_store_batch method is incomplete; only first few lines present.
